adopt: Grade one clip on your own GPU and get the master back, without opening an app.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Creative work is the last thing most people will hand to somebody else's machine, and the first thing every creative SaaS requires. The pipeline is not the hard part -- grading, mastering, avatar export and LoRA training are all solved -- the hard part is that reaching them means a GUI a human sits in front of, so an agent cannot help and the footage has to travel.

Install
builds in-tree (AitherOS/packages/awforge) -- no PyPI package yet; published when it is
synopsis: A render pipeline you drive from an agent
